Lay a region's transcripts out in rows

Source: R/methylationTrack_helpers.R
INTERNAL_meth_transcripts.Rd

Full gives each transcript a row of its own, as sesame::visualizeRegion() does. Collapsed overlays a gene's transcripts on one row, as IGV's collapsed view does, and genes that overlap take separate rows.

Usage

.meth_txn_model(txns, region, view = "full", types = NULL)

.meth_full_rows(span, exons, cds)

.meth_collapsed_rows(span, exons, cds, gene, region)

.meth_clip(features, region)

Arguments

txns

A GRangesList of exons, or NULL.

region

A region, from .meth_region().

view

"full" or "collapsed".

types

Transcript types to keep; NULL or none keeps all.

span

A data frame of transcripts.

exons, cds

Data frames of owner, start and end.

gene

Each transcript's gene.

features

A data frame with start and end.

Value

A list of n (the rows), and spans, exons and cds data frames of row, start and end, clipped to the region. spans also holds label, strand and hover.

A list of spans, exons and cds with a row column.

A list of spans, exons and cds with a row column.

The features inside the region, cut at its edges.
